source: replay of the held-out test rows of the run, in passenger_id order, scored by the registered champion; not production traffic
uncertainty: The interval is a normal-approximation 95% interval for the mean cost per case over the 217 cases whose outcome had arrived. It is not a forecast and not a guarantee for later cases. A cost that is above the approved range is a finding to act on; one inside it does not show the model caused any business result, because no counterfactual was observed.
